As we celebrate the 2nd International Day of Clean Energy, the world is going electric —fast. 2025 is a defining year in the global transition, with renewables set to become the world’s largest source of electricity for the first time, driving a revolution that promises cleaner air, healthier communities, and equitable growth.  
 
Yet, challenges remain. To meet the UAE consensus of tripling renewables and doubling energy efficiency by 2030, we must amplify efforts this year with a focus on:  
 
1️⃣ Advancing inclusive and sustainable energy storage and critical mineral supply chains to support renewables and EV adoption;  
2️⃣ Leveraging digital, data and AI for transformative energy innovations while balancing its rapid progress with inclusive governance;  
3️⃣ Mobilizing finance through innovative mechanisms and financial de-risking to close the $3.8 trillion investment gap; and 
4️⃣ Expanding decentralized renewable energy to reverse the recent setbacks in energy access.   
 
We know what works—this is the time to scale. Read our latest bulletin here to learn how 👉 bit.ly/seh-bulletin-2025
